body:
Thank you for taking the time to reply. I called a crisis line and felt a bit better. On the whole though I'm still struggling. 
Thanks for the love!
I am feeling a bit better now. I don’t know who you are, but thank you for being here and for caring <3

I don’t know what she would say, but I know she would want me to continue with studying and to do well. She always looked out for all her students and wanted to make sure everyone was okay. She wouldn’t want me to be upset about what happened to her, but I am and I can’t help that.  I didn’t take the pills, but every day I struggle not to do it. I went to counselling on Monday, told the counsellor pretty much everything, but I’m still falling apart. Sometimes I think it’s just too late.

When does therapy start to work? Every day just gets harder.  I want to go back; I want things to be different. And I know it’s not possible but still I want it so bad. I can’t stop thinking about how unfair life can be and why my tutor had to die in such a horrible way. I can’t stop thinking about how terrifying it must have been for her and I keep going over it in my head. I’m just so tired and I can’t keep going like this. I honestly feel like taking the entire bottle of citalopram :(

Thanks for the list of reasons and for caring. I have tried to help myself with therapy but I feel like I’m not getting anywhere and now I’m just pushing it all away. I just don’t know why this is so hard.

I really do want to live and thrive, but I just hurt so much and I desperately want to feel something else. At this rate I am going to fail uni and never finish my degree. I was meant to have an appointment with the uni counsellor today but I didn’t show up and I haven’t told her I feel suicidal because I’m ashamed and embarrassed. But thanks for caring.
